title: cmd/podman: enrich config load failure with rootless namespace context

Fixes: #30047

### Description

In rootless mode, Podman joins an existing user and mount namespace via `pause.pid` or `ns_handles` before Go runtime initialization runs. When an existing pause process outlives storage media re-enumeration (such as USB device re-enumeration) or references a stale mount table, opening configuration files (`storage.conf`, `containers.conf`) fails with filesystem errors like `EIO` or `ENOENT`. Without execution namespace context, users diagnose phantom storage media hardware failures rather than identifying the stale joined namespace.

This change:
1. Adds `RootlessNamespaceInfo` and platform helpers in `pkg/rootless` to inspect active user and mount namespace identifiers, pause PID state, and join sources.
2. In C shortcut namespace join, records `_PODMAN_JOIN_SOURCE` and `_PODMAN_PAUSE_PID` in the environment.
3. In `cmd/podman/registry/config.go`, enriches configuration load error reporting when running rootless, identifying active namespace details and recommending `podman system migrate` when filesystem errors occur.
4. Adds automated unit tests in `cmd/podman/registry/config_test.go` and `pkg/rootless/namespace_test.go`.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
Enrich configuration load error reporting in rootless mode with active namespace details and recovery guidance when encountering filesystem errors.
```
